name: Grok CLI (RHEL)
description: Installs the Grok CLI (xAI) with the vendor installer, as grok and agent.

agentVersion.description: Grok CLI version to install, e.g. 1.0.77. Leave empty to install the newest stable release at install time; that exact version is pinned and does not float on later rebuilds of the same layer.

pluginMarketplaces.description: Space-separated list of Grok plugin marketplaces (owner/repo, git URL) to add on container creation, e.g. 'anthropics/claude-plugins-official'. Setting this or plugins also installs git. Best-effort: a marketplace that cannot be added is logged and skipped rather than failing container creation. Leave empty to add none.

plugins.description: Space-separated list of Grok plugins to install and trust on container creation, as plugin@marketplace, e.g. 'chrome-devtools-mcp@claude-plugins-official'. Each marketplace referenced here must also appear in pluginMarketplaces. Best-effort: a plugin that cannot be installed is logged and skipped rather than failing container creation. Leave empty to install none.
